sentences.en: That really is really what drove me into this project is to try to understand, you know, as the world changes, what will it mean for our lives?

sentences.en: I watched as towering plumes of smoke billowed from distant hills in all directions and air tankers crisscrossed the skies.

sentences.en: Like many Californians, I spent those weeks worrying about what might happen next, wondering how long it would be before an inferno of 60-foot flames swept up the steep,

sentences.zh: 长满青草的山坡向我家逼来，并在脑海中反复排练我的家人该如何逃生。

sentences.en: I also had a longer-term question about what would happen once this unprecedented fire season ended.

sentences.zh: 两年来，我一直在研究气候变化将如何影响全球人口迁移。

sentences.zh: 我走访了四个国家，亲眼目睹气温上升是如何迫使气候难民逃离世界上最贫困、最炎热地区的。

sentences.en: In recent years, summer has brought a season of fear to California, with ever-worsening wildfires years closing in.
